cad_audit.limitations: Bounds and occurrence counts come from STEPControl_Reader placement inventory; no field labels or collision semantics were inferred.

semantics.visual: PASS: original field meshes unchanged; 118 explicit user-requested side closure pieces added. Visual openings are sealed while robot tunnels remain open in sampled passage checks.
semantics.collision: PASS within declared sampled 6 mm tolerance: dense source-face centroids, top/four-side rays, repair hull surface samples, all 18303 repair contact probes; 224 bounded tunnel rays unchanged. See collision_model.validation and limits.
semantics.targets: NOT_RUN: no target or gameplay semantics are present in the source CAD
semantics.runtime: PASS: standalone directory compiled and ten dynamic spheres stepped at 2 ms on MuJoCo 3.15.0; static fusion preserves all geom/site world transforms.

visual_update.material_encoding: per-geom display RGBA from user MuJoCo visual export; no texture files

dock_addition.placement: Two H-marked CAD platform centers measured from visual_020 vertices at z=1.6 m; XY = +/-(1.03237595,1.03237595); yaw=45 degrees
dock_addition.semantics: Reuse legacy four-slot dock approximation; not an official CAD structure or certified contact model

retired_collision_baseline.method: one axis-aligned bounding box per placed STEP solid
retired_collision_baseline.reason: Whole-solid AABBs filled free space and omitted faces; replaced by convex partitions of actual visual surfaces.

collision_model_baseline.method: convex partitions of bounded-error surface planes; finite centered shells
collision_model_baseline.source_layer: visual_update.mesh_files, placed according to visual_geoms.xml; dock additions excluded
collision_model_baseline.limits: Minimum planar patches below 0.001 m^2 and some curved details omitted; small fastener holes filled; finite shell and silhouette effects remain. No exact CAD, whole-field certification or flight claim.

validation.mode: headless sphere contact and geometry audits; EGL appearance comparison

collision_model_baseline.converter_tests: 6 passed; includes concavity, touching holes, transformed surfaces, shared reflected shells and thin-shell drop/impact
collision_model_baseline.simulator_suite: 161 passed in 83.46 seconds; no flight benchmark claim

collision_model.method: Retained partitioned shells, exact side closures, sampled ripple height fields, and source-face-derived convex patches; static bodies fused at compilation

surface_face_centroids.classification: Exact nearest triangle distance for normal-ray outliers; source faces buried inside user-approved closures excluded.

collision_model.limits: 6 mm is a sampled geometric acceptance tolerance, not an everywhere or robot-motion guarantee. Faces <= 1e-5 m^2 are not exhaustively tested. Finite shell silhouettes can alter distant first-ray hits; record both raw ray discrepancy and nearest-surface distance. Legacy docks remain approximations. No controller, wheel traversal or high-speed impact certification.

terrain_repair.authorization: User requested all black side openings closed; explicitly preserve traversable robot tunnels. This is a simulation alteration to official field geometry.
terrain_repair.source_meshes: All 131 original .msh files retain their visual_update manifest hashes. Source license/provenance unchanged.

closure_geometry.visual_collision_pairing: Same mesh asset and same transform, separate geom roles; no colliding visual geom.

terrain_repair.render_check: EGL: visual, collision-only and overlay inspected; highland, platform, central and reverse views checked. Preview artifacts remain outside runtime asset repository.

side_closure_collision_baseline.method: Retained partitioned surface shells, exact convex side closures, and sampled ripple height fields

moving_support_probes.distal_ray_note: Unbounded rays also reach the modified ripple road; those remote hits are excluded from the 3 m tunnel segment.

side_closure_collision_baseline.limits: Sampled terrain validation only. Global top grid retains 67/10500 first-hit differences >20 mm and a 2.566 m maximum around silhouettes/central mechanisms. No full-field exactness, robot/controller/flight or high-speed impact claim. Historical generator alone does not regenerate the user-requested repair.

surface_alignment_repair.source: Unmodified visual_update.mesh_files; source-face indices in surface_repair_sources.json

merging.note: Merge only convex projected footprints; no broad bounding-box filling. Hull samples separately verified against referenced source triangles.

surface_alignment_repair.roles: All added patches collision-only, group 3, contype=conaffinity=1; original visual geometry unchanged. Previously approved 118 side closures retained.
surface_alignment_repair.static_fusion: compiler fusestatic=true eliminates static body bookkeeping; all geom and site names/world transforms preserved. Static body IDs/names are not retained in the compiled model.
surface_alignment_repair.benchmark_baseline: Previous approved closure/ripple version: no surface repair includes, fusestatic=false; same probes, timestep, solver and MuJoCo version. Additional fused-baseline timing available below.
